claim: The committed lane-column grid families are inherent to the shipped klt asap7sc7p5t PDN recipe, not a stale transcription of it. Statically, the committed power block equals the 0.9.2 preset table except the one measured deviation r5 records (M5 offset 0.306 vs the preset's 0.312, the core-origin adjustment the tool docs themselves direct for this floorplan). Measured, a full place-and-route re-run with the preset-exact offset, same netlist and seed, leaves V4.M4.EN.1 (648), V4.M5.EN.2 (12) and M3.S.2 (15) byte-identical and introduces M5.AUX.1 = 32 whose markers all sit at M5 strap edges 6 nm off the 24 nm grid. M5.W.3 (46 -> 0) is route-dependent, not strap-geometry-bound: it trades against M5.AUX.1 through the one field that positions the straps, and neither setting clears both. No committed file changed in this pass; the committed-stream measurement of record remains r5.

scope.measured_here: a scratch routed slice generated from a copy of layout/pnr/slice.pnr.json with the preset-exact M5 offset (0.312); the scratch worktree, request copy, GDS, netlist and SDF were discarded after the run and only hashes and counts are recorded here
scope.why_no_committed_stream_rerun: both committed streams are byte-identical to the ones r5 measured (hashes re-verified below), and r4 already demonstrated byte-identical inputs give byte-identical counts, so re-running DRC on them adds no information

straps.M5: identical except offset: committed 0.306, preset 0.312 (w 0.216 / p 5.4 / sp 0.312 are the preset's)

static_comparison.connects: identical (M2<->M5 max_columns 1 ongrid {M3 M4}; M5<->M6 max_columns 1)
static_comparison.conclusion: the committed grid is the current shipped recipe, transcribed explicitly because the preset form is still unreachable with post_route_sdf at this pin (klayout-tools#6029 open), with the single documented deviation
static_comparison.the_deviation_is_tool_sanctioned: the pin's docs/cli/place-and-route.md, asap7sc7p5t section: pdngen offsets are core-origin relative, the edge-grid result was measured with core origin 0.96 um, and other origins can leave M5.AUX.1/M6.AUX.1 hits - adjust power.straps explicitly in that case. This floorplan's core origin x is 1.026 um; r5's request_change.why_m5_offset_0p306 measured the strap edges off-grid at 0.312 and on-grid at 0.306

m5_aux_1_markers.interpretation: the recipe-exact offset puts every M5 strap edge at 6 mod 24 nm at this core origin, exactly as r5's request_change.why_m5_offset_0p306 derived from the floorplan DEF and as the pin's preset docs warn for non-0.96 um core origins; M6.AUX.1 stays 0 because the M6 offset 0.344 already lands on the 32 nm grid here

V4.M5.EN.2.upstream: klayout-tools#4499 and the pin's preset docs (measured ~13 on the tool's own tiny block)

M3.S.2.evidence: count 15 under both strap offsets; pdngen M2<->M5 stack M3 stubs closer than the deck's 40 nm along-track spacing at some rail pitches
M3.S.2.upstream: klayout-tools#6030, closed completed 2026-11-17: no connect tuning moves them; residual documented post-pin by klayout-tools#6180 (merged 2026-11-17, after the 0.9.2 cut, so the pin's docs do not carry it yet)

M5.W.3.verdict: route-dependent, not recipe-inherent; not clearable by the preset form either
M5.W.3.evidence: 46 -> 0 on the same netlist when the strap offset moved 6 nm: the family follows the route TritonRoute produces under the strap blockages, and the offset that removes it is the one this core origin cannot use (it introduces M5.AUX.1 = 32)
M5.W.3.upstream: klayout-tools#6453 (filed from this trace, generic): TritonRoute M5 landing patches can exceed the M5.W.3 width buckets under PDN-strap congestion; no request field moves them

The committed streams are unchanged and remain measured by r5, whose envelopes (slice_routed.r5, lane_column.r5) stay the current committed-stream envelopes
